title: Preserve ownership of live Human Benefit Reports after archive
outOfScope: Rewriting any existing archived Work Item evidence.
Adding a generic exemption for generated Human Benefit Reports.
Changing unrelated Work Item lifecycle, release, or provider policy.

sources.reason: Owns the archive transaction that regenerates reports after moving active evidence.
Defines exact validator-bound ownership for active generated reports and no-active ownership behavior.
Validates final PR ownership against archived Work Item evidence.
Authoritative corrective requirements and observed archive supersession failure.
Historical PR evidence demonstrating the report-path ownership omission.

riskAssessment.reason: The correction must preserve immutable archives while making the post-archive report pair precisely attributable and rejecting stale or malformed reports.

reasons: Archive integrity and generated-evidence ownership require the standard governed verification profile.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized autonomous execution and the issue defines a bounded archive-ownership correction.

preReviewWarnings: Do not mutate historical archive evidence to repair ownership.
A valid report pair must remain exact-outcome-bound; malformed, stale, and cross-task reports must remain unowned.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: An archive transaction that refreshes a valid Human Benefit Report records both report paths in the same archived Summary that owns the transaction.
No-active/PR diff ownership classifies that exact valid post-archive report pair as owned by its archived Work Item without a generic report-file exemption.
Malformed, stale, missing, or cross-task report pairs remain unowned after archive or supersession.
Archive, ownership, and PR-bundle regressions cover the positive and negative paths, and lifecycle documentation describes the precise ownership rule.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
rawUserRequest: Execute the authorized remediation plan to completion. For issue #638, preserve precise ownership of live Human Benefit Reports after archive supersession without bypasses or generic exemptions.

rawRequestSource.reference: conversation: continuous authorization to execute the remediation plan and record it in every Work Item Contract

declaredIntent.summary: Bind post-archive Human Benefit Report paths to the immutable archive transaction that regenerated them.

intent.problem: Archive supersession can regenerate the live Human Benefit Report after the active Summary has moved, while the archived Summary omits the two report paths. A subsequent no-active ownership check then truthfully rejects a valid report pair as unowned.
constraints: Keep archived evidence append-only and immutable after archival.
Preserve strict exact validator binding for a report pair and reject stale, malformed, missing, or cross-task artifacts.
Do not manually stage/delete reports or introduce a generic ownership exemption.
Run the governed archive, PR, hosted, merge, and closure lifecycle.
intent.rationale: The archive transaction is the only authoritative operation that knows it regenerated a report from the rewritten archived Outcome, so it must bind the report paths to the same immutable Summary before freezing the archive.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: archive refresh records an exact valid report pair in the archived Summary
scenarioCoverage.expected: The transaction appends both report paths before freezing the immutable Summary and archive manifest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Archive-transaction regression asserts the report paths are present in the archived Summary and immutable manifest-consistent bundle.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: no-active and PR ownership accept only the archived transaction's exact valid pair
scenarioCoverage.expected: Diff and PR ownership resolve the valid pair to the archive transaction rather than granting a generic exemption.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Ownership and PR-bundle regressions exercise no-active and archived transaction paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: malformed, stale, missing, and cross-task report pairs remain unowned
scenarioCoverage.expected: Each invalid variation is rejected as unowned even after active evidence is archived.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Negative ownership regressions tamper, remove, stale-bind, and cross-bind report artifacts.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert only this Work Item diff; never rewrite existing archived evidence or manually remove generated report files.
